newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Cash market very strong but expect seasonal price retreat soon.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Cash still strong but easier index may limit any gain.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Strong cash hog indications and firmer product market.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.200 to 1.000 cent. Out-of-town bullish, continued light hog kill and product seen improving.
